scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man in a cream tunic and terracotta mantle stands beside a muddy patch and a loop of muddy footprints in a sunlit stone courtyard. Clear water pours into a fountain beside a folded cloth, olive branches and flowering plants.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard is not an event reported in the verse. The returning muddy footprints picture continuing in sin, while the freely flowing fountain suggests abundant grace. The traveler pauses over the question; the mud neither supplies nor increases the water. The comparison illustrates the mistaken inference Paul raises, without portraying sin as a way to obtain grace.
